Yes, it can. Beta blockers generally keep your heart rate lower and flatter, so heart rate zones and max heart rate formulas often stop being reliable. How that plays out for you, and what's safe at your intensity, is a question for the doctor who prescribed them, so ask them before you lean on any zone numbers.

On the training side, many people on these medications go by effort instead, like the talk test or a 1 to 10 scale. If you'd like, I can build your runs and sessions around that.
